prior: IC04-IC07 fixed symlink and response size risks, but storage root may exist with group/world write/read permissions. Existing object can be writable and altered after manifest.
H1: Owner/mode checks on root, shard, objects and files will reject unsafe pre-existing permissions without changing normal 0700/0600 behavior.
H0: All pre-existing permissions are already confined and no negative mode case is accepted.
tests: existing digest file world-writable rejected despite valid hash
normal temp private 0700 root and 0600 file accepted
unsafe manifest mode rejected or deliberately migrated without silent trust
acceptance: Native tests + API stability; no chmod of untrusted existing file to hide problem.
R5: No claims of Windows permission parity
